builds.name: Reference: Physical pick
builds.goal: Reference for Pyke: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A roaming pick-and-execute assassin who hooks targets, crosses them with a returning stun and resets his ultimate on eligible deaths. The kit's bonus-health conversion means tank packages are an intentional weak/high-risk comparison, not ordinary extra HP. Keep R execute threshold and cash earned from kills finite. Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Pyke: The kit's bonus-health conversion means tank packages are an intentional weak/high-risk comparison, not ordinary extra HP. Keep R execute threshold and cash earned from kills finite.

Start with the early core (Youmuu, then Profane Hydra) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Pyke either stabs an enemy in front of him or pulls an enemy towards him. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Low health and defense; spell shields/proc cooldowns must be reset between tests.

The route fails Pyke's stated kit question: The kit's bonus-health conversion means tank packages are an intentional weak/high-risk comparison, not ordinary extra HP. Keep R execute threshold and cash earned from kills finite.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Low health and defense; spell shields/proc cooldowns must be reset between tests.
Full cost 15,750 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Youmuu, then Profane Hydra. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Edge of Night, Serylda's Grudge, Guardian Angel are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.

kitEvidence.formula:
Tap: Pyke stabs, dealing [100 / 150 / 200 / 250 / 300 + (0.75) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to the first enemy hit, preferring champions. They are then Slowed by [90]% for [1] second.

Hold: Pyke throws his harpoon, dealing [100 / 150 / 200 / 250 / 300 + (0.75) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to the first enemy hit and Pulling them towards him. They are then Slowed by [90]% for [1] second.

If Pyke successfully hits an enemy champion or the channel does not complete successfully, [75]% of the Mana cost is refunded.

Pyke stores [0.09 + (0.002) × Stat(29)] of damage taken from champions, increased to [0.4 + (0.004) × Stat(29)] when there's more than one enemy nearby. Pyke can store up to [80 + (8) × AD[statFormula=2]] damage. While unseen by enemies, he rapidly regenerates this stored damage.

Additionally, Pyke converts all Maximum Health increases to Attack Damage instead at a rate of 14 Health to 1 Attack Damage.

Pyke strikes all enemy champions in an X, teleporting to and executing targets below [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=250, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 40.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 10, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 30.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 12, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 20.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 17, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 10.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2] + (1.5) × Stat(29)] Health. Champions above the threshold and non-champions instead take physical damage equal to [50]% of that amount ([(characterLevelBreakpoints(start=250, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 40.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 10, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 30.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 12, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 20.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 17, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 10.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2] + (1.5) × Stat(29)) × (0.5)]). 

When an enemy champion dies inside the X, Pyke can Recast this Ability for free within [20] seconds. If he executed that champion, the last assisting ally will also get kill gold. If he did not, he will still get kill gold as if he did.

Pyke dashes, leaving a drowned phantom behind him that returns to him shortly. The phantom Stuns for [1.25 + (0.01) × Stat(29)] seconds and deals [100 / 150 / 200 / 250 / 300 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to champions.
Pyke gains Camouflage and [45 + (2) × Stat(29)]% Move Speed decaying over [5] seconds.
